g.title: Domain-specific ML/AI system (e.g. ATO Reasoner) that assembles Observations from raw events via Feature Engine → Scorer → Assembler and submits them to DecisionLedger via the ReasonerContext + GateContext contracts.
Inspects persisted Decision Bundles in PostgreSQL; runs the eval suite to review retrieval quality, faithfulness, and decision consistency.
Governed decision framework: ML + LLM policy gate with deterministic enforcement and full audit replay.
LLM inference for the policy gate.
